description: The rounds one iteration of the ReAct repair loop (babeldoc/magazine/react/) is made of. A decision is asked for one detector kind at a time: a round shows the findings of that kind alone and the actions that answer for it, and the model still chooses freely inside the round, including to apply nothing. One iteration is every round taken once, so the iteration ceiling and the convergence guard in configs/repair_actions.json keep counting what they counted before. 'kind_order' is the order the rounds are taken in and is the whole of the declaration: no code reasons about which kind a round is for, it only walks this list. Every kind a detector raises appears here exactly once and nothing else appears at all, so a detector added without a place here is a configuration error rather than a kind whose findings silently never reach a decision. The order takes the actions that only move ink or only escalate before the one that recomposes a paragraph, so that within one iteration a geometric repair is measured against the layout the iteration started from rather than against one a text rewrite has already moved. A kind no action answers for keeps its declared place even though its round is skipped for want of anything to choose, so that giving it an action later does not also move the rounds around it.
